definition: A letter issued and signed by the province or territory where a student will study, confirming they hold one of that jurisdiction's allocated spaces. Since 22 January 2024 most new post-secondary students at the college or undergraduate level must include one with their study permit application.
longform: It is a separate document from the institution's own letter of acceptance and comes from a different authority. Quebec applicants provide the attestation of issuance of a Quebec Acceptance Certificate instead.
